about_the_game:
The Mad House : Season One

Welcome to The Mad House — a brutal game show where only the cunning, the skilled, and the downright lucky will survive. Step into a twisted arena of traps, enemies, and mind-bending challenges as you fight your way through 10 deadly rooms, each with its own theme, rules, and personality. Your prize? A chance to stand in the Hall of Legends… if you can make it that far.

The Challenge

Every room is designed to break you. Some will overwhelm you with relentless AI swarms, while others test your wits with puzzles, time limits, or hidden paths. The deeper you go, the tougher the opposition becomes — until you face mini-bosses, and ultimately the Big Boss, who guards the gates to the Hall of Legends.

Tools of Survival

  • Carrot Pickups – Collect points to spend in the Market between rooms.

  • Weapon Upgrades – Improve your arsenal to keep pace with rising difficulty.

  • Companion Bots – Call in Medic or Attack Bots to fight by your side.

Room Types

  • Teleportation Rooms – Blink across space in an instant, but be ready for the surprise on the other side.

  • Hidden Rooms – Discover secrets for rare rewards.

  • Timed Rooms – Race against the clock before the walls close in.

  • …and many more twisted surprises.

The Ultimate Goal

Defeat the mini-bosses not once, but twice, survive the gauntlet of unique challenges, and face the Big Boss. Only then can you etch your name into the Hall of Legends.

Do you have the guts to take on The Mad House?

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600 / GTX 750 / AMD R7 250
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Step into The Mad House, a futuristic cyberpunk game show! Battle waves of enemies, conquer unique room challenges, and climb the Leaderboard. Upgrade your gear, master each fight, and earn your place in the legendary Hall of Legends.
